sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cerbnat is an obscure Irish heroine. The Book of Invasions names her as one of the five wives of the hero Partholón. The others are Aifi, Elgnad or Dealgnaid, Cichban, and Nerbgen. She is otherwise unknown.
